counterexample: Take W_i c-stable with \overline{W}_i = W_i and F^0 D_dR(W_i) = 0 (the situation for gr_i of the metabelian quotient, which is Tate-twisted of positive weight). Then the displayed LHS equals dim D_dR(W_i) - [dim D_dR(W_i)/F^0 - dim H^0(G_R, W_i)] = dim W_i^{c=1}, while the RHS as written is dim W_i - dim(W_i \cap gr_i(U_n)^{c=1}) = dim W_i^{c=-1}. Any W_i with dim W_i^{c=-1} > dim W_i^{c=1} (e.g. a two-dimensional piece on which c acts by -1 with a one-dimensional c=+1 part) violates the asserted inequality. The correct superscript is c=-1, which is also the only version supported by Lemma \ref{silly_injectivity} in the next line.

The first step that fails is the displayed inequality at line 0687. From the corollary of Conjecture BK just proved (line 0676), dim H^1_f(G_{Q,T},\overline{W}_i) = dim H^1_f(G_{Q_p},\overline{W}_i) - dim H^0(G_R,\overline{W}_i) = dim D_dR(\overline{W}_i)/F^0 - dim \overline{W}_i^{c=1}, so dim D_dR(W_i) - dim H^1_f(G_{Q,T},\overline{W}_i) is bounded below by dim \overline{W}_i^{c=1}, i.e. by dim W_i - dim(W_i \cap gr_i(U_n)^{c=-1}), not by dim W_i - dim(W_i \cap gr_i(U_n)^{c=1}) as asserted. The two differ (they are the c=+1 and c=-1 dimensions), and the version printed is not implied by anything proved. The error is not cosmetic: line 0689 invokes Lemma silly_injectivity to say the right-hand side is positive for infinitely many i, but that lemma only produces an injection W_i^{c=-1} -> W_{i+1}/W_{i+1}^{c=-1}, i.e. it shows the codimension of the c=-1 part is positive (equivalently dim W_i^{c=1} > 0); it gives no information at all about dim W_i^{c=-1}, which is what the printed right-hand side computes. So both the inequality itself and its use in deducing case (2) of Theorem finiteness under Bloch-Kato fail as written; the parallel step for case (1) at line 0629 uses c=-1, confirming the intended superscript. Note the source has many harmless typos elsewhere (e.g. the sign of the lift (c(w),w) at 0766 corrected by the computation at 0768, H^{i-6} for H^1 at 0738 corrected at 0745-0746, the c=1 superscript at 0756 corrected by the sentence immediately following); the failure at 0687 is different in that nothing in the surrounding text repairs it and the subsequent deduction depends on it.
